SELECT org.* FROM ( SELECT org1.* FROM scc_base_organization org1 WHERE org1.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{organization.parentOrganizationIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION SELECT org2.* FROM scc_base_organization org2 LEFT JOIN scc_base_organization org1 ON org1.ORGANIZATION_ID = org2.PARENT_ORGANIZATION_IDS WHERE org1.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{organization.parentOrganizationIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION SELECT org3.* FROM scc_base_organization org3 LEFT JOIN scc_base_organization org2 ON org2.ORGANIZATION_ID = org3.PARENT_ORGANIZATION_IDS LEFT JOIN scc_base_organization org1 ON org1.ORGANIZATION_ID = org2.PARENT_ORGANIZATION_IDS WHERE org1.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{organization.parentOrganizationIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION SELECT org4.* FROM scc_base_organization org4 LEFT JOIN scc_base_organization org3 ON org3.ORGANIZATION_ID = org4.PARENT_ORGANIZATION_IDS LEFT JOIN scc_base_organization org2 ON org2.ORGANIZATION_ID = org3.PARENT_ORGANIZATION_IDS LEFT JOIN scc_base_organization org1 ON org1.ORGANIZATION_ID = org2.PARENT_ORGANIZATION_IDS WHERE org1.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{organization.parentOrganizationIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) org
AND org.ORGANIZATION_TYPE_CODE = #{organization.organizationTypeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND org.ORGANIZATION_CODE like concat('%', #{organization.organizationCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND org.ORGANIZATION_NAME like concat('%', #{organization.organizationName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND org.ORGANIZATION_REGION = #{organization.organizationRegion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND org.START_DATE <= CURDATE() AND (org.END_DATE is null or org.END_DATE >= CURDATE())
AND org.END_DATE <= CURDATE()
ORDER BY org.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
